defaultDesc:
If checked, disables some background details,
decreases loading times and improves performance.

If unchecked, disables anti-aliasing, increases performance
at the cost of sharper visuals.

If unchecked, disables shaders.
It's used for some visual effects, and also CPU intensive for weaker PCs.

If checked, allows the GPU to be used for caching textures, decreasing RAM usage.
Don't turn this on if you have a shitty Graphics Card.

Keeps decoded big textures (VRAM budget ~1.5GB) after leaving a song, so replaying the same song
skips decoding entirely. Pixel-identical; turning off flushes the cache immediately.

While preloading, trims fully transparent borders off big character sheets (>=2048px)
in memory and packs frames tightly, shrinking VRAM and upload time.
Pixel-identical rendering; original files are never modified.

During play, frees CPU-side copies of large textures (>=2048px) once they are uploaded to the GPU.
Rendering is pixel-identical; saves a lot of RAM on songs with big character sheets.
Press ENTER to release all unused cached images from memory, including the LRU pool.

Disables hxcpp garbage collection while playing.
Trades memory for stable frame time (H-Slice style).
Re-enabled automatically when leaving the song. Use with care.

Separates rendering from game logic so they can run at different speeds.
Game logic stays at your set framerate while rendering can go higher.
May improve FPS on high-refresh monitors without breaking physics.
The framerate at which game logic (physics, animations, input) runs.

The framerate at which the game renders.
Can be higher than Update Framerate when Separate Update/Draw is on
for smoother visuals on high-refresh monitors.
Choose your window mode (Press ACCEPT to apply changes).

If checked, the game will continue running even when minimized or unfocused.
Overrides Auto Pause setting.

If checked, the game will reduce volume when unfocused.
Only works when Run in Background is enabled.

Play an animation before the window closes when you press Alt+F4 or click X.
Off: close instantly.
Squeeze: squish the window height first, then the width.
Zoom: shrink everything toward the center.
Drop: shrink while falling down.
Slide: shrink while sliding to the left.
How fast the close animation plays. 1.0x is the default speed; higher values play faster.
